title: Delivery Charge Tariff by Order Value Band — Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment
content:
## 1. The tariff

The delivery charge billed on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is the amount this schedule
gives, for the fulfilment service the order was placed under, against the band the value of that order falls in.
The three bands are the same on every service — order values from 0.00 to 34.99, order values from 35.00 to 299.99,
and order values of 300.00 and above — and only the amounts differ from one service to the next.

Delivery is free where the order value reaches the service's free delivery threshold: at or above that figure no
delivery charge is billed, whichever band the order value would otherwise fall in. Where the service takes the
member threshold, the Circle tier's threshold replaces the service's own.

| Fulfilment service | 0.00 to 34.99 | 35.00 to 299.99 | 300.00 and above | Free delivery threshold | Member threshold replaces the service's own |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 6.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | yes |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Threshold Delivery | 49.00 | 49.00 | 29.00 | 1499.00 | yes |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 89.00 | 89.00 | 59.00 | 1999.00 | yes |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 199.00 | 199.00 | 149.00 | 4999.00 | no |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 245.00 | 245.00 | 175.00 | 9999.00 | no |

## 2. The same tariff read as three findings

- The band is the one the order value falls in, and the delivery charge is the amount that band's column holds for
  the service the order was placed under.
- Where the order value stands at or above the service's free delivery threshold, the delivery charge is nil.
- Where the service is marked as taking the member threshold, the figure the order value stands against is the
  Circle tier's threshold, in place of this schedule's threshold column.

## 3. Band and threshold boundaries (hypothetical order values)

On Threshold Delivery, an order value of 299.99 falls in the band from 35.00 to 299.99 and the delivery charge is
49.00; an order value of 300.00 falls in the band of 300.00 and above and the charge is 29.00. The same service's
free delivery threshold stands at 1499.00, so an order value of 1498.99 is charged 29.00 while an order value of
exactly 1499.00 reaches the threshold and is charged nothing.

On Standard Parcel Delivery the free delivery threshold of 35.00 falls on the same figure as the foot of the middle
band, so an order value of 34.99 is charged 6.99 and an order value of 35.00 is charged nothing.

Store Pickup Hold carries a free delivery threshold of 0.00, a figure every order value reaches.

## 4. Points of judgement on the tariff

**Which figure governs where the order value sits in a band that carries an amount and at the same time reaches the
threshold?** The threshold. At or above the free delivery threshold no delivery charge is billed, so the band amount is not billed.

**Does the band depend on the price of the main item?** No. The band is found from the value of the order, not from
the price of any one line on it.

**What is compared where the service takes the member threshold?** The order value against the Circle tier's
threshold, that threshold standing in place of the service's own figure in the table above.
